proofs.description: Reject unsafe package specifications before Docker starts
Keep package input out of Docker control arguments
Enforce read-only roots and writable disposable work areas
Deny lifecycle TCP, UDP, DNS, private, gateway, and metadata access
Constrain acquisition to the exact public npm registry authority
Observe child, grandchild, native, and shell execution
Fail incomplete when the tracer dies or emits diagnostics
Keep forged syscalls, controls, and workflow commands out of evidence
Bound process, memory, descriptor, file, output, syscall, and time use
Fail closed without broad privilege or host namespaces
Produce one behavior set and stable digest across ten trusted runs
Link every added item to verified retained raw evidence
Verify provenance before cross-workflow policy use
